gf2-native.description: gf2 DvbT2BitInterleaver::interleave on a packed BitVec, built with -C target-cpu=native; warm cells run the timed call once, untimed, before calibration

gf2-native-control.description: identity control: the same gf2 native executable as the baseline arm, launched as a second arm; warm cells run the timed call once, untimed, before calibration

gf2-portable.description: scalar/compiler control: gf2 DvbT2BitInterleaver::interleave built with -C target-cpu=x86-64 (baseline x86-64, no target feature beyond SSE2); warm cells run the timed call once, untimed, before calibration

xdsopl-external.description: xdsopl/LDPC PCTITL template at commit 32357d8ad55a6a302c34e093759f0454e45cca56, C++ shim built with g++ -O3 -march=native -std=c++17; the timed call unpacks the packed frame to one int32 per bit, applies PCTITL::fwd and packs the result back; warm cells run the timed call once, untimed, before calibration
